game.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
game.blurb: Combat flight action game from NAMCO, released 2026-10-02. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Simulation. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0: only its Table of Contents is written; the Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Achievements and trophies subpages are linked but not written, so nothing was used. acecombat.fandom.com answers the API, with about 67 linked pages, including "Campaign", "Federation of Central Usea", "Sotoa-Usea War" and "Joker Flight"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Project_Live" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2288340 as "ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE". 33 of 55 Steam achievements are hidden. 32 of them look like mission names, listed in falling unlock order (95% to 53%); they are split into early, middle and late campaign chapters by that order, which is an estimate. "Ace of Aces" (hidden, 2.7%) has no sign of being a mission and sits in the late campaign chapter as a placeholder.
